messages.content: You write reusable Python skills for a text-based household environment. Reply with one ```python code block that defines solve(env, goal), and nothing else.

Skill interface (Python 3):
  def solve(env, goal): ...
  goal: str                      the task text, for example "put a clean apple in fridge."
  env.observation: str           the most recent observation; before the first command it is the room
                                 description, which lists the receptacles in the room
  env.step(command: str) -> str  executes one text command and returns the feedback (also stored in env.observation)
  env.admissible() -> list[str]  the commands that are valid in the current state
The episode ends as soon as the task is completed. At most 50 commands may be executed. Only the modules
re, collections, itertools, math, and string may be imported. solve must not read or write files.

Environment rules:
  Commands: "go to X", "open X", "close X", "take O from X", "move O to X", "heat O with X", "cool O with X",
  "clean O with X", "use X", "examine X", "inventory", "look". Invalid commands return "Nothing happens."
  Objects and receptacles carry instance numbers ("apple 2", "drawer 3"); goals name only their types.
  An object may be on any receptacle, including inside closed ones (drawers, cabinets, fridge, microwave, safe);
  a closed receptacle must be opened to see and take its contents. The agent holds at most one object.
  Heating uses a microwave, cooling a fridge, cleaning a sink basin, and lamps are turned on with "use".

The skill must handle every task of this kind: find an object of the requested type, cool it with a fridge, and put it in or on a receptacle of the requested type. Goal wording varies between tasks of the same kind.

Below is a successful episode of one such task. Write solve(env, goal) so that it completes this task and other tasks of the same kind in other rooms, with other objects and receptacles.

Room: You are in the middle of a room. Looking quickly around you, you see a cabinet 20, a cabinet 19, a cabinet 18, a cabinet 17, a cabinet 16, a cabinet 15, a cabinet 14, a cabinet 13, a cabinet 12, a cabinet 11, a cabinet 10, a cabinet 9, a cabinet 8, a cabinet 7, a cabinet 6, a cabinet 5, a cabinet 4, a cabinet 3, a cabinet 2, a cabinet 1, a coffeemachine 1, a countertop 3, a countertop 2, a countertop 1, a drawer 3, a drawer 2, a drawer 1, a fridge 1, a garbagecan 1, a microwave 1, a shelf 3, a shelf 2, a shelf 1, a sinkbasin 1, a stoveburner 4, a stoveburner 3, a stoveburner 2, a stoveburner 1, and a toaster 1.
Goal: cool some bowl and put it in shelf.
Episode:
> look
You are in the middle of a room. Looking quickly around you, you see nothing.
> go to toaster 1
You arrive at toaster 1. On the toaster 1, you see nothing.
> go to stoveburner 1
You arrive at stoveburner 1. On the stoveburner 1, you see a pot 1.
> go to stoveburner 2
You arrive at stoveburner 2. On the stoveburner 2, you see a pan 1.
> go to stoveburner 3
You arrive at stoveburner 3. On the stoveburner 3, you see a pot 2, and a pot 1.
> go to stoveburner 4
You arrive at stoveburner 4. On the stoveburner 4, you see a pan 2, and a pan 1.
> go to sinkbasin 1
You arrive at sinkbasin 1. On the sinkbasin 1, you see a cup 1, a knife 3, a ladle 2, and a tomato 3.
> go to shelf 1
You arrive at shelf 1. On the shelf 1, you see a bowl 1, and a dishsponge 1.
> take bowl 1 from shelf 1
You pick up the bowl 1 from the shelf 1.
> go to fridge 1
You arrive at fridge 1. The fridge 1 is closed.
> cool bowl 1 with fridge 1
You cool the bowl 1 using the fridge 1.
> go to shelf 1
You arrive at shelf 1. On the shelf 1, you see a dishsponge 1.
> move bowl 1 to shelf 1
You move the bowl 1 to the shelf 1.
